visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene starts at an outdoor street-side restaurant with a yellow sign. A person's hand marks a pink order form with a pen. People in casual clothes are queuing in front of a glass food display case. (2) A red bowl containing sliced pork chop, white rice, green cabbage, and bamboo shoots is placed on a blue checkered tablecloth. A hand uses chopsticks to lift a thick, breaded pork chop slice, showing the juicy meat. (3) A large slab of braised pork (kong rou) with layers of fat and lean meat is displayed in a bowl. Chopsticks lift the meat to show its texture. The background shows an indoor eatery setting with simple furniture. (4) A metal spoon lifts grey oysters and ginger slivers from a bowl of clear soup. Steam rises from the hot broth. The blue checkered pattern of the table remains visible. (5) A female staff member wearing a red apron and a mask packs lunch boxes at a stainless steel counter. The video ends with a wide shot of the yellow storefront sign titled 'Huang Jia Fan Guan' (黃家飯館) and a scooter parked in front.
